tree.heading: Business incubator
tree.text: The term “business incubator” means an organization that—

children.text: provides physical workspace and facilities resources to startups and established businesses; and
is designed to accelerate the growth and success of businesses through a variety of business support resources and services, including—
access to capital, business education, and counseling;
other services intended to aid in developing a business.

tree.heading: Eligible applicant
tree.text: The term “eligible applicant” means an applicant eligible to apply for a grant under section 5803(b) of this title.

tree.heading: Indian tribe
tree.text: The term “Indian tribe” has the meaning given the term in section 5304 of this title.

tree.heading: Institution of higher education
tree.text: The term “institution of higher education” has the meaning given the term in section 1001 of title 20.

tree.heading: Native American; Native
tree.text: The terms “Native American” and “Native” have the meaning given the term “Indian” in section 5304 of this title.

tree.heading: Native business
tree.text: The term “Native business” means a business concern that is at least 51-percent owned and controlled by 1 or more Native Americans.

tree.heading: Native entrepreneur
tree.text: The term “Native entrepreneur” means an entrepreneur who is a Native American.

tree.heading: Program
tree.text: The term “program” means the program established under section 5803(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Reservation
tree.text: The term “reservation” has the meaning given the term in section 1452 of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

tree.heading: Tribal college or university
tree.text: The term “tribal college or university” has the meaning given the term “Tribal College or University” in section 1059c(b) of title 20.
